title: Traditional Saudi Arabian Paella
description: A classic Saudi Arabian dish made with saffron-infused rice, caramelized onions, and a blend of spices. This paella is perfect for a romantic dinner or a special occasion.
instructions: Heat oil in a large paella pan over medium heat.
Add the caramelized onions and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the smoked paprika and cook for 1 minute.
Add the rice and stir to coat with oil and spices.
Add the chicken broth, saffron, and sugar. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the diced tomatoes and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Serve hot and garnish with fresh herbs, if desired.
